desc:
🥚 Welcome to Save an Egg!

The egg stealers are on the run! Chase them down, slide in for the rescue, and hatch your dream pet collection. Watch out—rival players are ready to slide into you and steal your credits! 💨

HOW TO PLAY:
🔍 Find stealers carrying stolen eggs!
💨 Slide into them to knock the eggs loose!
🥚 Slide over dropped eggs to scoop them up!
✨ Time your flip through the golden ring for a PERFECT RESCUE!
🏡 Bring rescued eggs safely back to your plot!
🐣 Hatch amazing pets that earn money for you!

COMPETE & EXPLORE:
💥 Slide into other players and grab their credits!
⚡ Train your speed to catch faster stealers!
🌎 Explore new biomes and take on new chases!
🌟 Discover powerful Secret pets and grow your collection!

Every egg needs a rescue. Make the next one yours! 🥚

👍 Enjoying the game? Like, favorite, and join our community to support Save an Egg!
